title: PendingInput
description: What an agent is waiting for from the user before it can continue. Carried in AG-UI shared state when a run pauses.

prompt.description: The question, in the agent's own words.

options.description: Choices the agent offers. Absent means a free-text answer.

allow_free_text.description: Whether an answer outside the offered options is accepted. Defaults to true when there are no options.

capability.description: The capability being asked about, when this is an approval rather than a question.
